title: Research Associate, Analytical Development
desc: About GenScript Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions. Position Summary GenScript is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Research Associate, Analytical Development to support the development, qualification, and routine execution of analytical methods for RNA, lipids, lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), and related bioconjugates at our Seattle site. The successful candidate will perform hands-on laboratory work across HPLC/UHPLC, LC-MS, nano flow cytometry, and RNA/LNP analytical testing. This role will support routine sample analysis, analytical method development and optimization, troubleshooting, and method transfer in close collaboration with R&D, QC, Production, and other cross-functional teams. This position is well suited for a scientist who combines strong wet-lab skills with attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a desire to build technical expertise in emerging RNA and lipid nanoparticle technologies. Key Responsibilities 1. Chromatography and Analytical Testing Prepare RNA, oligonucleotide, lipid, LNP, antibody, and bioconjugate samples for analytical testing according to established procedures and experimental plans. Perform HPLC/UHPLC analyses using UV and/or charged aerosol detection (CAD), including sample and standard preparation, instrument sequence setup, chromatogram review, peak integration, and initial data assessment. Support chromatographic methods for evaluating RNA purity, lipid identity and purity, lipid composition, residual components, and related product-quality attributes. Assist with preparative chromatography, fraction collection, sample tracking, and evaluation of purification fractions for RNA and related development projects. Support analytical method development, optimization, troubleshooting, and transfer under the guidance of senior scientists and the group lead. 2. LC-MS Characterization Support LC-MS characterization of RNA, oligonucleotides, synthetic cap analogs, and related materials. Assist with characterization of attributes such as molecular identity, capping efficiency, and poly(A) characteristics, as appropriate to the method and project. Perform sample preparation and assist with spectral review, data processing, and interpretation under scientific guidance. Support troubleshooting of sample-preparation, chromatographic, mass-spectrometric, and data-processing issues. 3. RNA and LNP Analytical Development Perform analytical testing to support characterization of mRNA, circRNA, oligonucleotides, lipids, LNPs, antibodies, and related bioconjugates, depending on project needs. Support assays evaluating RNA attributes such as concentration, purity, integrity/fragmentation, aggregation, and residual process-related components. Support characterization of LNP-related attributes, including lipid composition and purity and residual/free components associated with LNP conjugation or formulation processes. Perform routine sample cleanup, dilution, buffer preparation, and analytical sample processing using appropriate RNase-free techniques. 4. Nano Flow Cytometry and Targeted LNP Characterization Prepare fluorescently labeled samples, standards, and appropriate experimental controls for flow-cytometry analysis. Perform routine flow cytometer setup, instrument QC, sample acquisition, and application of established analysis and gating strategies. Support characterization of antibody-decorated or targeted LNPs, including evaluation of labeling and conjugation-related attributes where appropriate. Assist with optimization and troubleshooting of flow-cytometry-based analytical workflows. 5. Laboratory Execution and Data Analysis Perform routine wet-lab activities requiring accurate pipetting, serial dilution, buffer and reagent preparation, concentration measurements, and sample cleanup. Process analytical results using relevant instrument software and Microsoft Excel or equivalent data-analysis tools. Review results for consistency and data quality, prepare clear data summaries, and promptly communicate unexpected findings, deviations, or instrument issues to the group lead. Maintain accurate, complete, and traceable experimental documentation, sample records, reagent inventories, and laboratory records. 6. Laboratory Operations and Cross-Functional Support Support preparation and revision of SOPs, test methods, work instructions, and analytical documentation. Assist with routine instrument maintenance, laboratory organization, and method-transfer activities. Collaborate effectively with scientists and colleagues across R&D, QC, Production, and related functional teams. Follow applicable laboratory safety procedures, chemical-handling requirements, and site EHS policies. Contribute to continuous improvement of analytical workflows, laboratory efficiency, data quality, and technical capabilities. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline. 0-5 years of relevant academic or industry laboratory experience, preferably in analytical chemistry, biopharmaceutical characterization, nucleic acid analysis, or a related field. Hands-on experience with HPLC/UHPLC and/or LC-MS, including sample preparation, execution of established analytical methods, and basic chromatographic or analytical data review. Practical experience with flow cytometry, including fluorescent sample preparation, use of appropriate controls, data acquisition, and basic gating or data interpretation. Strong fundamental wet-lab skills, including accurate pipetting, solution and buffer preparation, dilution calculations, sample handling, and contamination control. Ability to follow written procedures and experimental protocols accurately and maintain clear, complete, and traceable laboratory records. Ability to use Microsoft Excel or similar software to organize, analyze, and summarize experimental data. Strong attention to detail, organization, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn new analytical technologies. Ability to manage multiple sample batches and experimental priorities while communicating progress, results, and technical issues clearly. Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary R&D environment. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline. Previous experience working with mRNA, circRNA, oligonucleotides, lipids, LNPs, antibodies, or bioconjugates. [...]

title: Machine Learning Scientist, Frontier Research, AI for Drug Discovery (AIDD)
desc: A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide. ​ The Opportunity Within AI for Drug Discovery, the Frontier Research team advances fundamental machine learning and statistics methods, motivated by real-world challenges in drug discovery. In biology and medicine, many important problems cannot yet be addressed with off-the-shelf machine learning approaches—they demand not only novel solutions, but also new paradigms for framing and thinking about the problems themselves. Instead of focusing on incremental improvements, we work on long-horizon ideas that require a creative and broad perspective, developing solutions at a level that can be instantiated for multiple internal and external applications. If you’re excited about this kind of research, join us on an impactful journey of innovation at Prescient. In this role, you will: You will develop new methods and frameworks for uncertainty quantification, statistical inference, and experimental design, motivated by the diverse problem settings that arise when using machine learning to guide decision-making across the drug-discovery pipeline. You are expected to contribute to and drive research projects that result in conference and/or journal publications and open-source code, and that foster cross-organizational collaborations and applications. You are expected to engage actively in knowledge dissemination, presenting your work & expertise at internal and external scientific conferences. You will collaborate closely with our team in South San Francisco, New York, and Basel, Switzerland. Who You Are Must be pursuing, or have completed within the last 12 months, a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computational Biology, or related technical field, or have demonstrated equivalent research productivity. Demonstrated expertise in (any paradigm of) uncertainty quantification for decision-making, e.g., sequential/online statistical inference, experimental design, conformal prediction, reinforcement learning, calibration, game-theoretic statistics, etc. Proven publication record and experience contributing to the research community, including at conferences like NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AISTATS, UAI, etc., and/or relevant journals. Excellent skills in technical writing & communication, as well as collaboration and interpersonal skills. Preferred Experience with developing machine learning and/or statistical methods for biological/clinical data is desired, but not necessary. Experience developing open-source packages preferred. Relocation benefits are NOT available for this job posting The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of California, is $147,600 - 274,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits #ComputationCoE #tech4lifeComputationalScience #tech4lifeAI Genentech

title: AI Scientist - Agentic Engineering
location: Paris France Linz Munich London Berlin remote
desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.



The Role

Mistral AI is looking for AI Scientists with deep machine learning expertise and hands-on engineering experience to expand what Mistral's agentic tools can do across the engineering lifecycle across CAE (CFD, FEA etc) and EDA/Semi.. 

Within AI4Engineering Science, your core work is building the pre and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real engineering tasks. Alongside this, you'll help shape the agent architectures and harness that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step engineering workflows, not just answer isolated questions.

You'll work closely with domain experts across CAE and EDA to ground this work in how engineers actually work, and with the broader research team to translate that domain grounding into training signal and evaluation benchmarks that measure genuine task competence.

What You Will Do

 - Design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for engineering tasks across CAD, CAE, and semiconductor/EDA

 - Define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for each engineering task, beyond surface-level plausibility

 - Design and improve agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call tools, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon engineering workflows

 - Build evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling to identify where models fail on engineering tasks, and trace those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding

 - Collaborate with domain experts across CAEand EDA (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which engineering workflows are highest-value to target next

 - Contribute to Mistral's broader pre and post-training research, sharing findings and methodology across the science organization

What We're Looking For

 - Fluent English with excellent communication skills, able to explain technical ML and engineering concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences

 - Deep, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development

 - Demonstrated experience running, debugging, and validating real engineering workflows in at least one of CAD, CAE, semiconductor simulation, or EDA. 

 - You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments

 - Self-directed, you don't need detailed roadmaps to make progress

 - Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of engineering and ML

It would be great if you

 - Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks)

 - Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training

 - Have industrial or academic experience with CAE, or EDA tools (e.g. SolidWorks, CATIA, Fluent, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, STAR-CCM+, Cadence/Synopsys/Siemens EDA tools)

 - Have contributed to a large open-source or industry codebase

 - Have publications in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, JFM, AIAA, etc.)

 




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

title: Research Scientist, Modeling of Readout and Reset, Quantum
location: Goleta, CA, USA ; Los Angeles, CA, USA
desc: As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. Google Quantum AI's goal is to build a practically useful quantum computer. Modeling of readout and reset team aims at quantitative understanding of error mechanisms of these operations, resulting in operation improvement and development of new schemes with advanced performance. Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Experience with numerical simulations of quantum systems and with high-performance computing tools. Experience collaborating with experimentalists on quantum computing projects or analyzing/modeling experimental data. Experience with microwave engineering of superconducting qubits. Experience with error correction codes. Familiarity with circuit Quantum Electrodynamics (cQED). PhD degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with modeling of qubit systems. Experience in programming using Python. title: Specialist.HR People Analytics
desc: Summary: The Specialist.HR People Analytics serves as a key analytical contributor within the Total Rewards Center of Excellence (CoE), functioning as a primary resource for transforming raw workforce data into clear, actionable insights across the employee lifecycle. This individual supports enterprise reporting, maintains interactive dashboards, and executes hypothesis testing for HR business partners and senior leadership. Leveraging Oracle platforms (Fusion Data Intelligence, Oracle Analytics Cloud, OTBI/BIP) as the primary tools and Tableau as a secondary analytics platform, this role bridges workforce reporting and business decision-making with a commitment to data-driven outcomes and full ownership of analytical deliverables. Additionally, this role incorporates Generative AI capabilities (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) as a productivity engine to optimize complex Excel modeling, write and troubleshoot SQL scripts, and accelerate analytical deliverables. The ideal candidate embraces innovation fearlessly, collaborates inclusively across functions, and elevates the quality and accessibility of workforce data in service of a greater organizational purpose. Duties and Responsibilities: Workforce Reporting & Oracle Administration: Extract, consolidate, reconcile, and maintain workforce data using Oracle HCM Fusion, OTBI, BIP, and Oracle HCM Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI); maintain an established publication schedule for weekly, monthly, and semi-annual reports across integrated and non-integrated systems, taking full accountability for accuracy and timeliness. SQL Scripting & Data Extraction: Write basic SQL scripts and modify existing query logic to extract, validate, and clean workforce datasets from enterprise databases, applying data-driven decision-making to fulfill evolving business requirements. Dashboard Development & Maintenance: Create, update, and refresh executive-ready dashboards and scorecards utilizing Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) and FDI as primary platforms and Tableau as a secondary visualization tool, enabling leadership to make informed, strategic decisions. GenAI-Assisted Workflow Optimization: Proactively utilize Generative AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) to draft and troubleshoot complex Excel formulas, refine SQL code syntax, automate repetitive reporting steps, and synthesize unstructured narrative data, boldly embracing innovation as a force multiplier for productivity and quality. Advanced Excel Modeling & Analysis: Apply advanced Excel functions (XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, dynamic array formulas, nested logic) to execute headcount trend analyses, wage studies, and ROI program evaluations that support CoE strategic priorities. Employee Listening & Survey Analytics: Support enterprise employee listening strategies (e.g., Perceptyx); aggregate, clean, and analyze survey response data to evaluate drivers of engagement, performance, and retention risk, elevating the employee experience through data-informed insights. Cross-Functional Partnership & Hypothesis Testing: Partner with HR Business Partners, Compensation, Talent Management, and Business Unit Leaders to formulate hypotheses, gather requirements, perform cost and value analyses, and translate raw data into strategic business cases, intentionally uniting across functions to drive collective success. Regular or Temporary: Regular Language Fluency: English (Required) Work Shift: 1st shift (United States of America) Please review the following job description: Perform sophisticated analytics (statistical and predictive analytics, machine learning modeling, etc.) to provide actionable insights that improve business outcomes and minimize risk and also provide consultation to business leaders and other stakeholders on how to leverage analytics insights and build strategies around analytics. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time. 1. Independently perform sophisticated data analytics (ranging from classical econometrics to machine learning, neural networks, and natural language processing) in a variety of environments using structured and unstructured data. 2. Produce compelling data visualizations to communicate insights and influence outcomes among a wide array of stakeholders. 3. Take accountability and ownership of end-to-end data science solution design, technical delivery, and measurable business outcome. 4. Engage in stakeholder meetings to identify business objectives and scope solution requirements. 5. With minimal guidance, write, document, and deploy custom code in a variety of environments (Python, SAS, R, etc.) to create predictive analytics applications. 6. Use, maintain, share and collaborate through Truist internal code repositories to foster continual learning and cross-pollination of skillsets. 7. Actively research and advocate adoption of emerging methods and technologies in the data science field, with the eye of continually advancing Truist’s capabilities. 8. Exercise sound judgment and fosters risk management culture throughout design, development, and deployment practices; partner with cross-functional teams to coordinate rules on data usage, data governance and analytics capabilities. QUALIFICATIONS Required Qualifications: The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Bachelor’s degree and zero to four or more years of experience in a quantitative field such as Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or Engineering, or equivalent education and related training 2. Exhibit understanding of statistical methods, including a broad understanding of classical statistics, probability theory, econometrics, time-series, and primary statistical tests 3. Familiarity with linear algebra concepts for optimization, complex matrix operations, eigenvalue decompositions, and principal components; working knowledge of calculus/differential equations, with understanding of stochastic processes 4. title: Senior Associate, Data Science - Compliance Model Risk
desc: Senior Associate, Data Science - Compliance Model Risk Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. In Capital One’s Model Risk Office, we defend the company against model failures and find new ways of making better decisions with models. We use our statistics, software engineering, and business expertise to drive the best outcomes in both Risk Management and the Enterprise. We understand that we can’t prepare for tomorrow by focusing on today, so we invest in the future: investing in new skills, building better tools, and maintaining a network of trusted partners. We learn from past mistakes and develop increasingly powerful techniques to avoid their repetition. In this role, you will: Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals The Ideal Candidate is: Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. Basic Qualifications: Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date: A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analytics A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration Preferred Qualifications: Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) Experience working with AWS At least 2 years of experience in Python, Scala, or R At least 2 years of experience with machine learning At least 2 years of experience with SQL Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. desc: Sr Data Analyst I, RWE ** Hybrid SERBIA ** Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress. Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape. Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know: Why Syneos Health • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life. • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. Job Responsibilities JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND REQUIREMENTS Contribute to the design of RWE studies, including protocol development, ability to lead statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and other key study documents with minimal/modest supervision; must be able to lead SAP development without supervision for “straightforward” studies, e.g., treatment patterns, purely descriptive studies. Apply comprehensive knowledge of real-world data sources (e.g., claims, EMR/EHR, registries, omics data, wearable data, PROs) to inform study design, feasibility assessments, and methodological decisions. Strong fluency in at least one of SAS or R is mandatory. Perform advanced statistical analyses using SAS, R, Python, SQL, and/or other appropriate tools, ensuring data quality, reproducibility, traceability, and methodological rigor. Develop operational definitions, code lists, and analytical specifications aligned with study objectives and industry standards. Prepare high-quality tables, figures, and listings (TFLs) and contribute to study reports, manuscripts, and client deliverables with clear interpretation of findings and articulation of limitations. Experience in providing client-facing support, including presenting planning and project updates, explaining methodologies, addressing technical questions, and contributing to strategic discussions. Demonstrate a consulting-oriented approach by proactively identifying risks, proposing solutions, and adapting to evolving client needs. Manage programming timelines and analytical workstreams across multiple concurrent projects; communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively to internal and external stakeholders. Occasional support of proposal development, desk research, and exploratory analyses as needed. QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS Master’s degree or higher in Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Economics, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience (to demonstrate experience, explicit supporting evidence is required). 5 years (minimum of 3 years) of project-based experience conducting RWE research using secondary healthcare data sources (e.g., claims, EMR/EHR, registries, hospital databases, lab/genomic data, wearable data, PROs). 5 years (minimum of 2 years in a consulting setting) of hands-on statistical programming experience (e.g., SAS, R, Python, SQL) in a research or consulting setting. Strong understanding of RWE methodologies, observational study designs, bias and confounding control methods, and data governance considerations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with client-facing experience and preparing deliver-ready results and presenting to stakeholders. •Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight timelines. Demonstrated consulting mindset with the ability to translate analytical results into strategic insights and practical recommendations. Get to know Syneos Health Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients. No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. title: Research Scientist
desc: This role serves as a key member of the soybean trait introgression team while also supporting GM/GE trait pipeline processes and broader greenhouse operations. The position contributes to the timely delivery of high-quality trait introgression materials that align with project objectives and generates reliable experimental data to support plant selection and generation-advancement decisions. All responsibilities are performed in accordance with Syngenta’s Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies and applicable procedures. Accountabilities: Execute assigned soybean crossing, backcrossing, and generation-advancement activities according to approved protocols and project timelines. Manage plant growth, flowering schedules, and plant health through appropriate greenhouse care and coordination of integrated pest management activities. Maintain accurate plant identification, cross labeling, and pedigree records; ensure sample and seed traceability throughout the breeding cycle, including harvest, processing, and storage. Collect, validate, and enter experimental data into designated databases; summarize and present the results. Coordinate assigned trait introgression activities with greenhouse, breeding, analytical, and trait teams; communicate progress and promptly escalate technical issues. Support routine greenhouse operations, including planting, irrigation, tissue sampling, controlled pollination, harvesting, seed processing, and pest management. Must be able to work on a rotational basis as a weekend team member; Willing to work on holidays as needed. Degree in plant biology, agronomy, or closely related discipline from an accredited university; Minimum entry qualification of Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience. Good knowledge of plant physiology including soybean Soybean material traceability and data management Knowledge of greenhouse equipment and operations, and IPM Experience working with a major field crop such as soybean and corn Experience soybean cultivation and crossing under well controlled growth environments. Demonstrated expertise in soybean crossing, with high efficiency and consistently strong crossing success rates. Work consistently and accurately, with strong attention to detail, documentation, and traceability. Communicate clearly, coordinate effectively across teams, and raise risks early. Take ownership of commitments and adapt approaches as priorities or conditions change. Respond effectively to unexpected biological or operational issues while maintaining quality and meeting delivery commitments. What We Offer: A culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members. Offers flexible work options to support your work and personal needs. Full Benefit Package (Medical, Dental & Vision) that starts your first day. 401k plan with company match, Profit Sharing & Retirement Savings Contribution. Paid Vacation, Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, Education Assistance, Wellness Programs, Corporate Discounts, among other benefits.
